relationships.subject: hot tooth phenotype
relationships.evidence_quote: Severe pulpal inflammation can activate peripheral nociceptors, alter ion-channel and receptor signaling, promote neuroimmune crosstalk, and amplify pain processing within trigeminal ganglion and brainstem pathways.

key_findings: Review frames odontogenic pain, especially the hot tooth phenotype, as a translational model of trigeminal sensitization overlapping with headache-related orofacial pain.
Proposes alignment of clinical phenotypes, models, readouts, biomarkers and mechanism-guided therapies.
